body: ac-4 plumbing done + CLI glue validated on a tiny synthetic v6 FTMB (train saves value_attention config + 25 value_attn.* tensors; predict_multibranch scores it). NOT yet run at scale. LAUNCH (1-seed pilot, ~3.5-4h): STORE_VALUES=50 OVERRIDE_SEEDS=42 ./scripts/overnight_potion.sh --config models/m2v8m-attn-244-config.json --tag m2v8m-attn ; full 3-seed ~9-11h (drop OVERRIDE_SEEDS). Run in a tmux session (overnight_potion.sh tees to output/embed-frontier/overnight_m2v8m-attn.log). Value encoder = models/m2v8m (256d). ac-4 deliverable: best-of-3 Sense + composed vs m2v8m-s43 (0.522/0.794); does the Sense lift pass through to composed. ac-3 native-vs-predict_multibranch parity check runs in this same scoring step.

ac-4 RESULT (1-seed pilot, m2v8m-attn-s42): Sense 0.522->0.561 (+3.9pp, ~80% of gte's 0.571 lift) at ~2.3ms/col release CPU; composed 0.794->0.794 FLAT. Sense lift does NOT pass through to composed = 3rd confirmation composed is rule-bound (potion-size, gte, attention all ~0.79). VERDICT: NO-SWAP (documented outcome per ac-5, not failure); corpus-honest relocation gate not triggered (no promotion). Choice 0106 thesis VALIDATED on Sense (cheap cross-value attention ~= gte contextual lift, ~free latency). Single seed (gate wants best-of-3, ~40h at 21min/epoch) — only worth confirming if we pursue the rule-layer bet. Per-epoch 8x baseline (Metal small-op); halve via removing the double pool forward per batch if iterating. NEXT: the rule-layer bet (Sense->composed) is the real ceiling-break, now evidence-backed.

ac-3 closed as code-complete + contract-tested (save/load round-trip, embed_input_tensor single-encode). The native finetype-vs-predict_multibranch numerical parity did NOT run at scale — the 0.561 score came from predict_multibranch (training-side forward); native classifier parity is moot without a promotion (no-swap). ac-5 resolved as the documented no-swap outcome (composed flat) — no promotion, relocation gate not triggered.
